# Wikimedia fixtures

Real responses recorded on 2026-11-12 (about 11:45 UTC) with the project User-Agent:
pageview top lists (de, en; 10 Nov published, 13 Nov not yet: 404), three per-article
series (one with a `/` in the title, one missing article: 404) and one Wikidata
`wbgetentities` call. `index.json` maps each request URL to a gzipped
`{"status", "body"}` file; bodies are stored unchanged (decompressed).
